notes.title: Early Access Launch News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/02e77f2fe9c1f762a0af62327390bf75e2a5f53f.png[/img]

[b]Castra launch date:[/b]
[h3][b]February 20th, 10am PST[/b][/h3]

The game's price is $9.99 USD with a 15% launch discount from Feb 20th-27th.

We will be launching with 2 factions and 2 maps, with many more to come throughout this year.

Our mission is to make the best strategy game we possibly can. We need your input to make that happen! 

Share your thoughts and suggestions on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z]Discord[/url][/b].

Each faction has three unit types, here's a quick peak of what they're like.

[h3][b]Infantry (melee)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/d6fb40f17c7c86dfcf7f1ebec8f7019bdce46077.png[/img]
Infantry units are low cost, low health units that cause destruction on the battlefield. 
[b]Weakness[/b]
[b]Tanks[/b] are the most powerful against [b]infantry[/b]
[h3][b]Tank[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/4f9c9a6df5eed0fc67076da0e0123adfd43f1878.png[/img]
Tanks deal splash damage that destroys infantry, but is relatively weak against air units.
[b]Strength[/b]
[b]Tanks[/b] are the most powerful against [b]Infantry[/b]

[b]Weakness[/b]
[b]Planes[/b] are the most powerful against [b]Tanks[/b]
[h3][b]Bomber[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/f652d9dea066fd0be5b515d037bc224bf7e0805d.png[/img]
The bomber deals maximum damage to armored ground units. Tanks don't stand a chance.
[b]Strength[/b]
[b]Planes[/b] are the most powerful against [b]Tanks[/b]

[b]Weakness[/b]
[b]Infantry(ranged)[/b] are the most powerful against [b]Planes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/e8de85e4fb4a90cad7e54b491d90cd6c78d69aa0.png[/img]

[b]Add Castra to your wishlist![/b]

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/64cd133e9d22b4e76d2a15b22ef0839167f07be6.png[/img]

Happy Holidays guys! I hope everyone is looking forward to the new year, and enjoying some time off to take it easy and play games. We are going to hit the ground running in 2020 and I can't wait to share what we've been working on!

[h2]January Roadmap[/h2]
[b]Unit Tiers[/b]
Multiple unit tiers is something that has been planned from the beginning, and we are finally implementing it. Super excited to show this off.
[b]Combat AI[/b]
Rebuilt combat AI to make them more intelligent and interesting to battle
[b]New Faction[/b]
Hopefully we can introduce a third faction into the game this month!
[b]Public Testing(?)[/b]
We'll see if we get this far, would be awesome to get more player feedback :)


Happy Holidays!
Patrick from Red Fox Studios
